pages.ld_description:
Immerse yourself in a world of colors with 240 Plus-Plus pieces in the finest, fun rainbow hues. This tube contains everything you need to play freely and create all sorts of 3D constructions and flat 2D designs. Play with colors and create your favorite characters, funny patterns or even spinning tops! With Plus-Plus anything is possible.
%%%
Plus-Plus comes in a world of colors, and our Rainbow Colormix is no exception. In the tube, you will find Red, Orange, Yellow, White, Apple Green, Turquoise, Purple, and White. The colormix does not have a predetermined theme regarding what you can build – it is encouraging free play so you can easily create whatever comes to mind. With Plus-Plus, you get to decide how to play. The small pieces easily connect and suddenly, you have created your very own creation. You can build a flat design, or you can dive into creating a 3D creation. Either way, there is free play, and the many vibrant colors make playing with Plus-Plus even more fun.
Playing with Plus-Plus stimulates imagination and creativity, and you will see how your children patiently immerse themselves in play and creatively come up with more and more things to create. It is easy to come up with new things to create with Plus-Plus, and children have a special ability to see things that we adults often overlook.
